# Mana

Mana is a local macOS menu-bar app for Codex and OpenCode Go usage.
Website: https://mana.salsaparapizza.com/
Source and documentation: https://github.com/cris7ian/mana
Latest signed and notarized installer: https://github.com/cris7ian/mana/releases/latest
Requires macOS 13 or later. MIT licensed.

Use the menu-bar icon to see usage windows and reset times. Mana can connect to a ChatGPT account for Codex usage and/or an OpenCode Go API key. Codex uses a ChatGPT plan, not an OpenAI API key. Provider CLIs are not required.

Privacy: Usage snapshots are not persisted. Mana stores credentials as private plain-text files in ~/Library/Application Support/Mana/credentials/. Keep backups private. See the README for setup and CLI instructions.

Mana is not affiliated with OpenAI or OpenCode Go. For current behavior and installation instructions, consult the source repository and latest release rather than inferring account details from this page.
